description: This is a Java unit test class for the ConnectionOpened class, part of the connectivity events in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies behaviors such as equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ConnectionOpenedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ConnectionOpened, testing equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for ConnectionOpened class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ConnectionOpened class instances are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionIdString
methods.description: Tests that providing null as a String connection ID results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Tests that providing null as a ConnectionId results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that fromJson correctly deserializes JSON into a ConnectionOpened instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces the expected JSON representation of ConnectionOpened.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getResourcePath returns the correct resource path.
